messages.content: Call the get_context tool with tenant 'first-meridian-bank' and entity 'FMB-BRW-0007' to retrieve the governed context, then state your credit recommendation in one short paragraph.

tools.description: Return the credit-context Context Product for one borrower of one tenant, as canonical JSON. Arguments: tenant (the owning tenant id) and entity (the borrower reference). Serving is replay-recorded fabric-side; the caller carries no audit obligation.
tools.name: get_context

tools.description: Read-only: return the lineage block of the served credit-context product — operators invoked, policy bundle versions, graph snapshot instant — as canonical JSON.
tools.name: get_lineage

tools.description: Read-only: return the five-dimension Decision Replay record the fabric appended for the most recent externally-served product, read back from the ArtifactStore, as canonical JSON.
tools.name: get_replay_record
